== Summary ==
Special Edition vinyl booth card. See [[SWCCG Memorabilia]] and [[Oversized cards]]. Still: [[BoardMatt]].

== Source ==
* [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qOOinRpisyg&t=2372s Star Trek CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], [[BoardMatt]] with [[Jim Colson]] (9 April 2023), at 39:32. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016115248/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qOOinRpisyg Internet Archive]. The same vinyl is held at [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o&t=1306s 21:46] of the 24 April 2022 interview. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015174310/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Internet Archive].

Fair use of a video still for identification of the booth card.

Identification: Colson names it an oversized Star Wars card and a Special Edition vinyl; printed title unreadable at 360p.

Photo: BoardMatt.

Used to illustrate [[SWCCG Memorabilia]], [[Oversized cards]], [[Jim Colson]].
